pages.text: Carry On cannot pick up an entire entity wagon, wagon stools or straw mats. Normal wagon interactions remain available.$(br2)Picking up ordinary cargo follows Carry On’s current configuration. If its default sneak-use gesture conflicts with unloading, permitted cargo is picked up first; otherwise normal unloading applies.

Use an empty cargo slot while carrying a permitted block to load it with its contents. Wagon placement rules still apply. Use an empty stool while carrying an entity to seat it if clearance allows.$(br2)Custom Carry On keys remain separate from sneak-unloading. Maids still follow their riding-task rules.
